title: Switching to an internal customer clears a ticked No Charge
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, flagged as an Internal customer.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Work Order.
  2. Pick customer A.
  3. Tick the "No Charge" checkbox.
  4. Pick "Goodwill" in Category.
  5. Pick customer B instead.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Work Order window opens.

Step 2:

  • The "No Charge" checkbox shows.

Step 3:

  • The Category select appears.

Step 4:

  • Goodwill is picked.

Step 5:

  • The "Internal" badge shows next to customer B, and no "No Charge" checkbox or Category select shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
